name: Reliance Industries Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest private conglomerate: Oil-to-Chemicals (Jamnagar 1.4 mb/d refining plus petchem, fuel retail via Jio-bp), Jio Platforms (telecom, ~500m subscribers; listed separately on 28 Oct 2026 after a 5x-subscribed IPO), Reliance Retail (largest Indian retailer), upstream KG-D6, and New Energy (solar/battery giga-factories). Promoters hold 50.4%. Q2 FY27 profit rose ~41% on record O2C earnings and Jio strength; shares jumped 12% on 2 Nov, the best day since April 2020.

exposures.mechanism: Jamnagar ~1.4 mb/d = ~510m bbl/yr: +$2 = $1.0bn = Rs 9.6k cr = 4.9% of TTM group EBITDA (Rs 194k cr), x EV/MCap 1.15 x persistence 0.3 => +1.7. Q2 FY27 O2C EBITDA +68% on wide fuel cracks confirms the sign. Pack +0.41 (t +1.3) is in the same direction but smaller (HO=F proxy).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: profit +41%, O2C EBITDA +68%, O2C revenue +44% to Rs2.31 lakh cr (Reuters, Business Standard, Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: Offsetting channels: upstream (KG-D6, ~3% of EBITDA) and GRM benefit; petchem spreads compress when crude rises faster than product prices; retail (consumer spending) and Jio are largely insensitive. No significant pack link. Net close to zero.

Jamnagar exports ~55% of fuel output (~30 MMT of petrol/diesel/ATF). An export levy of Rs 6/L on ~36bn L = Rs 21.6k cr = 11% of EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.15 x persistence 0.2 (levies reset fortnightly) => -2.5; round to -3.0. Levies were reset repeatedly Aug-Oct 2026.

evidence.note: Export levies on petrol/diesel/ATF reset Aug-Oct 2026

exposures.mechanism: Polymers/polyester/PX EBITDA ~Rs 30k cr (model knowledge); +10% spread ~ +Rs 4k cr = 2% of EBITDA x 1.15 x 0.4 => +0.9; Q2 'chemical margins' also higher (Business Standard).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: profit +41%, O2C EBITDA +68%, O2C revenue +44% to Rs2.31 lakh cr (Reuters, Business Standard, Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: Net USD long operationally (export fuels/chemicals, upstream ~35% of EBITDA): +3% INR weaker = +Rs 2k cr (1% of EBITDA); offset by USD capex/imports for Jio/retail (devices), USD debt ($25bn gross, mostly hedged), and import-intensive retail. Net small negative in equity terms given foreign-investor selling on INR weakness; pack -0.96 (t -1.0).
Net debt ~Rs 1.4 lakh cr, 30% floating: 25bp = Rs 105 cr = 0.2% EBITDA; the effect is valuation duration on a 21.6x P/E growth conglomerate: ~2% per 25bp x 0.5 => -1.0.

+10% ARPU via tariff hike: Jio revenue ~Rs 1.2 lakh cr/yr x 10% = Rs 12k cr at ~90% flow-through = Rs 10.8k cr = 5.6% group EBITDA x 1.15 x persistence 1.0 (tariff resets structural) => +6.4; haircut for pass-through erosion and competition => +4.0. Jio Platforms listing on 28 Oct raised visibility of Jio value.

evidence.note: Jio Platforms listed 28 Oct 2026 after 5x-subscribed IPO; RIL +12% on 2 Nov (Reuters)

exposures.mechanism: Retail (revenue ~Rs 3.3 lakh cr, EBITDA ~Rs 25k cr) and Jio data usage: +5pp urban demand => retail EBITDA +7% = Rs 1.8k cr = 0.9% of group x 1.15 x 0.5 => +0.5; plus Jio => +0.8. Q2 retail was weak (NDTV Profit 2 Nov).
+10pp US tariff on India: direct export exposure of textiles/polyester small; the Russia-oil secondary tariff (100% threat, Sep 2026) is the main tail. -0.5.

evidence.note: US 100% tariff threat on Russian-oil buyers

exposures.mechanism: +1 = freer Russian crude access: discount on up to 0.5 mb/d ($2.5 x 180m bbl = $450m = Rs 4.2k cr = 2% of EBITDA x 1.15 x 0.3 => +0.7); but sanctions actions have previously forced RIL to halt Rosneft supplies, so downside range included.

evidence.note: US 100% tariff threat on Russian-oil buyers

exposures.mechanism: Hormuz disruption raises freight/insurance and crude sourcing cost (RIL imports ~60% from Middle East & Russia/US), but widens diesel/jet cracks (+) and supports Q2-type O2C windfalls; risk-off hits FII-heavy holdings. Net near zero with wide range; stock was -11% over 12m through the conflict.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: profit +41%, O2C EBITDA +68%, O2C revenue +44% to Rs2.31 lakh cr (Reuters, Business Standard, Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: FIIs hold 16.7% (down from 18.7% in Mar 2026) of a mega-cap index heavyweight; +$5bn net inflow/qtr => +2.5% market-adjusted.
Jamnagar AI data-centre JV (Google/Meta, model knowledge) and Jio cloud: acceleration of India data-centre demand adds optionality; +0.8.

company_links.mechanism: Unit: % change in JIOFIN equity value per +1% change in RELIANCE equity value. Jio Financial was demerged from RIL in 2023 and shares promoter-group holding entities and brand; sentiment and flow contagion, no earnings link.
